title: Desktop standalone client
description: Build a desktop client (Tauri or similar) for Windows/macOS/Linux. AGPL-licensed per the project license tier table. Reuses the WASM engine and Web Components from the browser client inside a native window. Adds: offline play, local game hosting, file-based game loading. Lower priority since the browser client covers most use cases.
close_reason: Superseded by baize-6abh (Flutter epic). Flutter targets Linux/macOS/Windows desktop natively.
